description: Composition-level, leak-free train/val/test split of the consolidated multi-property corpus (data/processed/consolidated_properties.csv.gz).
method: 1) Any composition present in the Materials Project pretraining corpus (data/jepa/mp.csv.gz, via composition_key) is confined to an eligible-for-train-only pool -- it can appear in train but never in val/test, preventing pretrain/eval leakage (same principle as scripts/build_tc_splits.py's composition-level leak filter). 2) From the remaining leak-free pool (255,132 / 312,149 compositions), val and test (10% each of the TOTAL corpus) are drawn via proportional stratified sampling on (has_experimental_Tc x has_mechanical_props x cif_source), seed=42, so rare labels (experimental Tc: 1.27% of rows; mechanical: 6.9%) are represented in both eval splits roughly in proportion to their overall prevalence, rather than being concentrated in train.
